# Drop rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0 (sentinel for missing)

# Compute change in biomarker from baseline to final
df_clean['change'] = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute mean change by arm
mean_change_by_arm = df_clean.groupby('arm')['change'].mean()

# Compute overall mean change
overall_mean_change = df_clean['change'].mean()

# Print results
print("Mean change by arm:")
print(mean_change_by_arm)

print("\nOverall mean change:")
print(overall_mean_change)"}
